title: Československé bursovní papíry 1938–1939
author: Josef Kašpar
edition_note: Modern retyping; PDF metadata2006; not a historical facsimile
selection: All14 noncentral-bank commercial/deposit-credit institutions headquartered in the Czechlands with full1933–37 tables in domestic banking chapter pp64–88 and unlisted-bank chapter pp228–235. No otherwise eligible entry in those chapters omitted.
selection_limit: Retrospective coverage of institutions represented in1938 handbook; not random sample, failure panel, national census, or confirmed LoN membership match. Institutions with Czech headquarters may operate outside Czechlands.
reconciliation: 196 prior endpoint observations match. All70 liability rows and69 asset rows sum to total within source rounding; Moravska1933 asset components20m below reported total, preserved.
original_report_search: Two search engines identify CNB archive catalogue and EconBiz Länder annual-report holdings1926–37, but no targeted original1935Escomp/1937Länder facsimile was obtained.
